description: This file contains deterministic, non-AI utility functions for data processing related to document management, chunking, keyword extraction, similarity computations, and embedding batch processing. It is part of a larger agentic RAG project and provides core processing functions that are likely imported and used elsewhere.

methods.name: str load_document(file_path: str)
methods.description: Loads the contents of a file given a file path.

methods.name: str create_chunk_id(text: str, index: int)
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a text chunk based on its content and index.

methods.name: List[Dict] simple_chunk_text( text: str, chunk_size: int = 500, overlap: int = 50 )
methods.description: Splits text into overlapping chunks based on size and sentence boundaries.

methods.name: List[str] extract_keywords(text: str, top_n: int = 10)
methods.description: Extracts the top N keywords from a piece of text based on frequency, excluding common stop words.

methods.name: float keyword_match_score(query_keywords: List[str], chunk_text: str)
methods.description: Calculates a simple score indicating how many query keywords appear in a chunk.

methods.name: float cosine_similarity(vec1: List[float], vec2: List[float])
methods.description: Calculates the cosine similarity between two vectors.

methods.name: str find_quote_in_chunk(claim: str, chunk_text: str, min_length: int = 20)
methods.description: Finds the most relevant sentence in a chunk that overlaps with a claim.

methods.name: List[Dict] deduplicate_chunks( chunks: List[Dict], similarity_threshold: float = 0.9 )
methods.description: Removes duplicate chunks based on normalized text similarity.

methods.name: List[float] embed_text(text: str)
methods.description: Embeds a single text string into a vector using an embedding manager.

methods.name: List[List[float]] embed_batch(texts: List[str])
methods.description: Embeds multiple texts efficiently in batch.

methods.name: float compute_similarity(emb1: List[float], emb2: List[float])
methods.description: Computes cosine similarity between two embedding vectors.

methods.name: List[Dict] rank_by_similarity( query_embedding: List[float], chunk_embeddings: List[List[float]], chunk_ids: List[str], top_k: int = 10, )
methods.description: Ranks chunks based on their similarity to a query embedding.

ctags.name: find_quote_in_chunk
ctags.pattern: /^def find_quote_in_chunk(claim: str, chunk_text: str, min_length: int = 20) -> str:$/

ctags.name: rank_by_similarity
ctags.signature: ( query_embedding: List[float], chunk_embeddings: List[List[float]], chunk_ids: List[str], top_k: int = 10, )

ctags.name: simple_chunk_text
ctags.signature: ( text: str, chunk_size: int = 500, overlap: int = 50 )
